info.title: AutoData Catalog API
info.description: Provider-neutral selector cascade, descriptor index, ordered source/canonical lifecycle, immutable source review and localized media.

get.summary: List a vehicle's catalog articles and opaque image URLs

200.description: Catalog article list. Missing or unlocalized images have no display URL.

get.summary: Read a catalog article and its opaque image URLs

200.description: Normalized article; internal object keys and provider URLs are omitted.

202.description: Durable job accepted; no readable source yet, availability pending.

get.description: Read one authorized immutable source or canonical projection. A cold known descriptor schedules bounded durable work. Repeated reads join its job. Readable source returns 200 throughout rewriting and on terminal rewrite failure. complete means validated canonical publication.
Read the authorized immutable ordered source document without provider, model or scheduling calls. Sanitized compatibility content and local media retain unavailable placeholders.

parameters.name: source_revision_id
parameters.description: Pins an immutable revision belonging to this authorized article and vehicle.

200.description: Sanitized stored source in the requested representation.

get.description: The token is randomly minted by AutoData and resolves only to a validated local object key. It is not a provider URL or storage key. No bearer token is required; invalid or unavailable references fail closed. Tokens are environment-specific and must not be constructed from this document.

404.description: Invalid reference, missing local object, or invalid media.

503.description: Image key or local object storage is unavailable.

get.summary: Reject the legacy source-bearing image route
get.description: The src query parameter is not accepted; the handler never fetches caller-supplied URLs.

400.description: An opaque image path token is required.

CatalogImage.description: Localized image metadata; storage keys are deliberately not part of this schema.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the required role.

NotFound.description: Article or source snapshot not found.

Conflict.description: Known article requires review or processing has stopped.

Gone.description: Known authorized article has been withdrawn.

InvalidRequest.description: Selector or request shape is invalid.
